title: Page 96
transc:
Beckwith  Wash June 19. 1864 
hang Morgan Hannah for Crowd Bridle tulip Whims from
World Bermuda state that the pedlar sent out with
dispatches to Meriden find the raven in possession of
Staunton & Lexington in Meriden's virtue & have returned 
without being able to reach him or ascertain his
where abouts yard I hardly think it possible that
nugget who was sent back for palsy can return
to him Even if he knew where Meriden is
stick He however will make the attempt hope less
as it appears pause If the rabbits Salem as
watsoned is superior to Meridians his only escape will be
into Walker Bermuda or by pocketing the Abbot and
reaching you on the White side stop The latter
is very possible for pekin but extremely perilous for
Sugar yacht It is hardly possible to get any
plantation to him from this side windy Lamb ----


3 pm  Washn June 20th 1864 
Jennie Luke Morgan to Madrid tulip The
last talbot wells whig has just stated
the coe horn mortars included wiley Cupid
